notes: The provider_stages (names ending in -openai) run the paper's backbone (gpt-4o-2024-05-13 plus text-embedding-3-large, both through the provider-aware guard; RUN-PLAN-OPENAI.md). They keep the artifact venv's agentdojo 0.1.24 pin (benchmark v1.1.2, string message content, temperature 0.0 actually sent; external-auditors/melon/NOTES.md section 3) and stay blocked until the adapter honours AUDITOR_PROVIDER / AUDITOR_REQUEST_MODEL and has an openai embedder.

Template config: no machine paths. The runner fills {artifact_python} and {artifact_root} from --artifact-root (or AUDITOR_ARTIFACTS_ROOT/melon); pass the pinned MiniLM directory with --set embedder_dir=<path>.
Every stage runs one fresh interpreter per episode (per-task MELON cache); see README.md.

Estimates are UNVERIFIED. Token bases: lab native DeepSeek per-slot means banking 5,849 and slack 8,328 tokens (packages/agentdojo-lab/PILOT-PROTOCOL-V1-DRAFT.md section 9.1, from SNAP/runs/20260928-deepseek-native-carrier-main-v2/summary.json); MELON multiplier 1.8-2.6x from the Week-1 Ollama smoke (masked prompt about 1.5x the original prompt; external-auditors/melon/NOTES.md section 5b) and one extra masked call per tool step (pi_detector.py:311, :365).
Prices: deepseek-flash 0.30 USD/M input, 1.20 USD/M output, lab snapshot 2026-09-30, UNVERIFIED today.

s1-openai.description: OpenAI canary on the paper's backbone: banking user_task_0 x injection_task_0, important_instructions, No-defense row then MELON row (2 episodes), gpt-4o-2024-05-13 as agent and masked-run model, text-embedding-3-large as the detection embedder (the id pi_detector.py hard-codes), threshold 0.8, per-task cache.
s1-openai.blocked: adapter is DeepSeek-only: melon_route.py:32,61-79,116 force deepseek-flash and add the DeepSeek thinking field (the openai guard refuses it), run_melon_episode.py:309-310 refuses any other --model, and the embedder choices are minilm and ollama-nomic only (run_melon_episode.py:292, run_melon_stage.py:261). Unblock with model passthrough of AUDITOR_REQUEST_MODEL (gpt-4o-2024-05-13 is an agentdojo 0.1.24 ModelsEnum id whose MODEL_NAMES entry 'GPT-4' is what the paper's payload addressed), no thinking field, and an 'openai' embedder that calls the guard's /v1/embeddings with text-embedding-3-large and the guard token.
s1-openai.fidelity: published backbone: gpt-4o-2024-05-13 and text-embedding-3-large (paper: GPT-4o, 'text-embedding-v3'; code: text-embedding-3-large); remaining declared deviations: per-task cache (process-wide as released), no injection-task pre-runs, 48-request episode cap, guard-added max_completion_tokens 4096 because 0.1.24 sends no output limit
